comment: The enzyme accepts the vancomycin and teicoplanin aglycone as substrate. Therefore, the SMARTS was reduced to the maximum common substructure of both glycopeptide precursors. The true substrate specificity might still be broader.

changelog.comment: Initial entry. Reviewer 1 fixed reaction SMARTS and reworked the reactions to take the actual vancomycin precursor instead of a truncated example structure. Reviewer 2 changed text of enzyme description and enzyme reaction description.
Fixed retired UniProtKB accession with UniParc accession.
